text:
incident-bot: Paging: High saturation in eu-west1 inference cluster — sustained queue growth and spike in p95 generation latency to ~2.1s. Auto-scaling struggling. Paging oncall.
jamal: oncall here, grabbing it. Any immediate customer-visible errors? :eyes:
emily: No 5xx, just elevated latency and token queueing. We've got some backlog on kv-cache nodes, looks memory pressure-y.
sre-oncall: Confirmed. Adding scale-up attempt (add 6 nodes) and fallback route to eu-west2. Beginning canary reroute for low-priority traffic.
jamal: Good. Product impact: a handful of mid-market customers in EU reporting slow autocompletes. CS is alerted.
product-ops: Draft status page note: "Operational degradation affecting inference in EU region causing elevated response times. We are scaling capacity and rerouting traffic; no data loss. ETA 20–30m." Safe to post?
emily: LGTM but add we may see transient errors for low-priority background jobs.
customer-success: Will send targeted message to affected accounts with apology + workarounds (reduce max_tokens to lower latency); prepping template now.
sre-oncall: Scale-up completed, nodes passing health checks. Started reroute; seeing immediate drop in queue length for canary traffic.
maria: Handoff in 10m — I’ll take second shift. Steps to observe: watch token-queue, p95, and host mem% via console. If latency remains >1.2s after 15m, escalate to runtime team.
jamal: Thanks, handing off to maria. Posting status page update now and notifying affected customers with the CS template.
incident-bot: Status update posted: "Investigating — elevated inference latency in EU region; mitigation in progress. Next update in 15 minutes." (link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3832109876)
product-ops: Customer notification draft shared in #customer-notifications; CC'ing account owners.
maria: Took over. Will monitor and follow runbook. If recovered, will post resolved update and close thread.
jamal: Appreciate the handoff. Quick note for postmortem: gather scaling logs, KV cache GC traces, and any routing decisions. Tag with P1-Latency.
customer-success: Sent customer messages. One replied asking for ETA — I told them ~30m and that we can throttle non-critical requests.
emily: Observed p95 dropping to 0.9s for canary after reroute. Continuing to monitor for 10m before full roll.
maria: If stable, plan to roll reroute to 50% in 5m. Will update here.
